annotation.justification: The clause states that an HTTP-based protocol MAY define its own SVCB mapping. This is a straightforward, unambiguous statement: it allows a protocol to define a mapping specific to itself. There is no missing constraint or alternative interpretation that would lead to materially different implementation behaviours.
